params.name: docPath
params.description: Name or path of the document/folder to get the icon of, or an empty string to prompt via the standard Open File dialog

params.name: size
params.description: Size, in pixels, of the returned icon picture

overloads.semanticRole: Fills icon with the icon of the document or folder designated by docPath (or prompts the user for one when docPath is empty), optionally at a requested pixel size.

constraints: If docPath is an empty string, the standard Open File dialog box appears and blocks for user input; the selected path is then available via the Document system variable.
docPath can name a file of any type (executable, document, alias/shortcut) or a folder; a relative name/pathname is resolved against the database's current working directory.
